title: Compare true and estimated paths
description: You display position estimates and selected covariance ellipses.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You select the first two columns of true_traj and xs. These arrays supply the true and estimated position coordinates.
You plot both paths on the same axes. Their labels distinguish True path from KF estimate.

steps.question: Does the loop draw a covariance ellipse for every estimate?
steps.answer: It draws four selected ellipses, using the first, two interior, and last covariance entries.

steps.description: You center each ellipse at its selected estimate and pass its position covariance block with the supplied nstd. The displayed chart labels both position axes in meters.
